title: ἵνα and purpose
subtitle: Read a purpose clause before translating it smoothly.
overview: ἵνα commonly introduces a purpose or result clause with the subjunctive in New Testament Greek.
Read the main clause first, then ask what goal or intended result the ἵνα clause supplies.

sections.title: Purpose-clause patterns
rows: so that he or she may have life

sections.title: Read purpose with the main clause

items.en: He comes so that they may have life.
I speak to you so that you may believe.
He gives to them so that they may see.
